/* ALL CATEGORY 사은품 스와이프 (행사 내용 2개 이상) */
.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:'Pretendard JP', 'Noto Sans Regular';}
._evt_hide {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}
._evt_header ._kv_txt {position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; height:100%; color:#fff; text-align:center; pointer-events:none;}
._evt_header ._kv_sub {position:absolute; left:0; top:97.06667vw; width:100%; font-size:4.8vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.12vw; line-height:5.06431vw;}
._evt_header ._kv_main {position:absolute; left:0; top:115.73333vw; width:100%; font-size:9.33333vw; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.02em; line-height:13.06667vw;}
._info_nav_flex ._nav_wrap ._nav_inner {display:flex; width:100%; height:14.66667vw; margin:0 auto; padding:0; background:#870000;}

._info_nav_flex ._nav_wrap ._nav a {position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:auto; height:100%; padding:0; text-align:center; font-size:4vw; font-weight:600; line-height:1.2; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6); white-space:nowrap;}
._info_nav_flex ._nav_wrap ._nav._current span::after {content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:0.8vw; background:#fff;}
._info_nav_flex._fixed ._nav_wrap {position:fixed; left:0; top:50px;/* <<<<<50 px 단위 고정 */ width:100%; z-index:100;}
._evt_content_1 ._bg_layer {position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; z-index:0;}

._beauty_tab ._tab {flex:0 0 auto; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:7.2vw; padding:1.86667vw 2.93333vw; border-radius:13.33333vw; background:#6D0C0C; font-size:2.93333vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.05867vw; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6); white-space:nowrap; transition:background 0.3s, color 0.3s;}
/* 채움 요소 (줄 길이가 달라 가로로 넘칠 때만 표시) */
._beauty_tab ._tab_fill {display:none; flex:0 0 auto; height:7.2vw; border-radius:13.33333vw; background:rgba(109,12,12,0.45); border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.2);}
._beauty_slider ._card {flex:0 0 auto; width:51.2vw; margin:0 1.6vw; border-radius:2.71059vw; overflow:hidden; background:#fff; transition:width 0.5s ease, border-radius 0.5s ease;}

._beauty_slider ._card ._info {display:block; padding:2.77333vw 3.2vw 3.2vw 3.2vw; background:#fff; color:#323232; text-align:left; font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif; word-break:break-word; transition:padding 0.5s ease;}
._beauty_slider ._card ._brand {display:block; font-size:2.98667vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0; line-height:3.6vw; transition:font-size 0.5s ease, line-height 0.5s ease;}

._beauty_slider ._card ._cond {display:block; margin-top:1.06667vw; font-size:2.66667vw; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-0.08vw; line-height:3.62275vw; transition:font-size 0.5s ease, line-height 0.5s ease, margin 0.5s ease;}
/* 사은품마다 요건이 다를 때: 요건 문구를 사은품 칸 수만큼 나란히 */
._fl_list {display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8vw; width:86.66667vw; margin:8vw auto 0 auto;}
._all_list {display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6.4vw 4vw; width:86.66667vw; margin:8vw auto 0 auto;}
._all_list ._gift_swipe {position:absolute; left:0; top:22.93333vw; width:100%; height:16vw; overflow:hidden; background:#fff;}
._all_list ._btn_next {position:absolute; top:28.8vw; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:4.26667vw; height:4.26667vw; border-radius:0.4vw; background:#666; z-index:5;}
._all_notice {width:100%; margin-top:8vw; padding:0 6.66667vw; font-size:2.93333vw; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-0.05867vw; color:#848484; text-align:center;}
